summary: The registrant filed a Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on June 18, 2026, attaching a press release titled 'AITX's RAD Announces Additional Healthcare and Construction Orders as Customers Expand Deployments.' The press release announces follow-on orders from existing healthcare and construction clients, including three RIO 180 solar powered security trailers and two RIO Mini units integrated with the SARA AI platform. No transaction terms, prices, or deadlines are disclosed. The filing is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation; it reflects routine business growth without any change of control, restructuring, or capital event.
